title: Green ACO: An Energy-Aware Ant Colony Optimisation for the MAX-SAT Problem with EI/J Scheduling and Thompson Sampling
abstract: arXiv:2611.28109v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: NP-hard combinatorial optimization problems demand heavy computation, and this raises real environmental concerns, especially in regions with carbon-intensive power grids. This paper presents Green ACO, an energy-aware Ant Colony Optimisation algorithm for the MAXIMUM SATISFIABILITY (MAX-SAT) problem. At its core is an Expected Improvement per Joule (EI/J) scheduler. At every iteration, it picks the operator that best balances expected quality gain against expected energy cost. Three operators feed the scheduler: WalkSAT, Focused Variable Neighbourhood Search, and Clause-Restart Greedy, ranging from cheap and surgical to aggressive and costly. An offline dual-regime profiling phase calibrates these operators before the search even begins, and, combined with Thompson sampling, this reduces uninformed early operator choices; online call-count warm-up still occurs. translated_title: Green ACO：一种结合 EI/J 调度与 Thompson 采样的面向 MAX-SAT 问题的能量感知蚁群优化算法
translated_abstract: NP-hard 组合优化问题需要大量计算，这引发了切实的环境问题，尤其是在电网碳密集的地区。本文提出了 Green ACO，一种针对最大可满足性（MAX-SAT）问题的能量感知蚁群优化算法。其核心是一个每焦耳期望改进调度器。在每次迭代中，它会选择在期望质量提升与期望能量成本之间取得最佳平衡的算子。三个算子为调度器提供选项：WalkSAT、聚焦变量邻域搜索和子句重启贪心，覆盖从廉价精准到激进昂贵的不同代价级别。离线的双状态剖析阶段在搜索开始之前对这些算子进行校准，并结合 Thompson 采样，减少了早期缺乏信息的算子选择；同时在线调用次数预热仍然保留。预调度守卫会在估计能量成本……时拒绝调用。
tldr: 本文提出 Green ACO，一种能量感知的蚁群优化算法，通过每焦耳期望改进（EI/J）调度器与 Thompson 采样，在求解 MAX-SAT 问题时动态平衡解质量提升与能量消耗，实现更加绿色低碳的优化计算。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Green ACO, an energy-aware Ant Colony Optimisation algorithm that employs an Expected Improvement per Joule (EI/J) scheduler with Thompson sampling to dynamically balance solution quality gains against energy costs when solving the MAX-SAT problem.
